title: Checkpoint: build the Sensor class
prompt: Rewrite the whole `Sensor` class from its spec table: `new Sensor(start)` stores the starting value; `read()` returns it; `tick()` adds 1 and returns nothing. State must persist across calls — three ticks after starting at 10 must read 13.

tests.name: sensor state
tests.hint: Field + constructor + two methods; mutation happens on the field.
